meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides SomaFM donation boxes, blurs channel art, hides listener counts, news box and channel blurbs
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out. SomaFM serves a stripped start page to phone user agents (one Open Player button, a donation box, a Desktop Site link; fetched with an iPhone UA in headless Chrome, 390x844) and the full channel grid to desktop browsers (desktop UA, server-rendered HTML evaluated in Chrome with scripts off). Counts are `querySelectorAll`: donation box/card/progress line 5 on desktop and 2 on the phone page, channel logos 223, channel blurbs 223, listener line 1, news box 1, footer 1. Everything is plain HTML with readable ids and classes (`#begathon`, `.BegathonMessage`, `#rhnews`, `#stations`); nothing depends on English text.

Channel logos are the only link to a channel page, so the choice is Show/Blur only. NOT verified: the player pages under /player24/ and channel pages, the guestbook and news pages, signed-in states, whether the donation box returns after a donation (the site sets a SomaDonated cookie for 30 days), and the original cookie and app-banner rules, which match nothing on this site.
